% `tex.web` §400: a macro argument is shown, but only so much of it.
%
%     begin_diagnostic; print_nl(""); print_char("#"); print_int(n); print("<-");
%     show_token_list(pstack[n],null,1000);
%
% §292's third parameter is a character budget, and `show_token_list` stops
% when it is spent and says `\ETC.`. Uncapped, an argument that ran away to the
% end of the file put the whole file back into the log — seventy-odd wrapped
% lines of it in trip's transcript, which is how this came up.
\catcode`\{=1 \catcode`\}=2 \catcode`\#=6
\tracingonline=1
% `show_token_list` emits its truncation marker with `print_esc`.
\escapechar=`\|
\tracingmacros=1
\def\m#1{}
\m{}

% ...and a short one is shown whole, with no marker.
\def\n#1{}
\n{short}
\end
